data.body: CLARIFICATION — “per-job SSM rotation” was imprecise and is superseded by “per-job SSM retrieval with externally managed replacement visibility.” Rebar does not generate replacement keys, schedule rotation, write SSM, select a rotation time, or coordinate trust-root era changes. ADR 0049 and the current service already fetch the current SecureString once at the start of each signing job, materialize it as a mode-0600 temporary file, use it for that job, and delete it. If deployment/operators replace the SSM value between jobs and perform the separately governed trust-root update, the next job naturally reads the new value; that is an observation consequence of the existing fetch cadence, not a Rebar rotation subsystem. RP-04 only proposes replacing the process-global key-path/principal/push environment handoff with context-local typed state. Recovery notes and probe labels were corrected accordingly; the probe still passes.
